name: cbio-paad-iatlas-prince-2022
alternateName: Metastatic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (PRINCE Trial, Nat Med. 2022) - iAtlas Harmonized
description: Whole-exome sequencing and neoantigen landscape analysis of 93 metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinomas and their matched normals from a randomized phase 2 trial evaluating the efficacy of nivolumab and/or sotigalimab with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel (chemotherapy) as first-line therapy for metastatic pancreatic cancer. The reprocessing of raw sequencing data is coordinated by CRI iAtlas.
